values.meaning: current cooldown reduced to this when Moonlight is consumed from the target

mechanics.claim: Diana dashes to the target's location and deals damage upon completion.
mechanics.quote: '''Diana''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location, and upon completion, she deals them {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Diana will attempt to basic attack the target after the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Diana''' will attempt to basic attack the target.

mechanics.claim: Diana can cast any of her abilities during the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''''Diana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''

mechanics.claim: Lunar Rush consumes Moonlight from all enemies upon ending the dash, even if interrupted, and this reduces the current cooldown drastically.
mechanics.quote: ''Lunar Rush'' consumes ''Moonlight'' upon ending the dash (even if {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}).

mechanics.claim: If blocked by spell shield, Moonlight is still consumed but the cooldown reset does not occur.
mechanics.quote: If ''Lunar Rush'' is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}} the ''Moonlight'' debuff is still consumed but ''Lunar Rush's'' cooldown is not reset.

mechanics.claim: Lunar Rush still deals damage even if the target becomes untargetable by the end of the dash.
mechanics.quote: ''Lunar Rush'' will still deal damage even if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} by the end of the dash.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown can also reset if the target dies during the dash while affected by Moonlight.
mechanics.quote: ''Lunar Rush's'' cooldown will also be reset if the target dies during the dash while being affected by ''Moonlight''.
